source_title: Past, Present, and Future of Productivity and Personal Agents
speaker: K (Kitze, founder of sizzy.co / creator of Benji / author of Wolver personal agent framework)
key_insight: The most honest public critique yet of OpenClaw as a life-OS container (cron/multi-agent/memory unreliable, Discord/Telegram wrong substrate, 'OpenClaw Anonymous' meetups), paired with Wolver's hierarchical-topic context injection and cron-as-first-class-UI-object patterns, and a role-inversion future where AI prompts the user with the next task instead of the user prompting the AI.
